# John Crawford Company

> Custom blinds, shades, shutters, drapery and upholstery, with consultation, measuring, installation and repair services from a Woodland Hills showroom (22311 Ventura Blvd #101, Woodland Hills, CA 91364). Visits by appointment, Monday to Saturday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Phone: (818) 884-5464.

Service area: Los Angeles, including Woodland Hills, the San Fernando Valley, Calabasas, the Conejo Valley, Simi Valley and Stevenson Ranch.

Pricing is not published. Quotes follow a free in-home consultation, where samples are brought to the home and windows are measured.

## Products

- [Blinds](https://www.johncrawfordcompany.com/blinds/): Hunter Douglas wood, faux wood, metal and vertical blinds
- [Shades](https://www.johncrawfordcompany.com/shades/): Hunter Douglas shade fabrics and controls
- [Motorized shades](https://www.johncrawfordcompany.com/motorized-shades/): Hunter Douglas PowerView, compatible controls, installation and setup
- [Plantation shutters](https://www.johncrawfordcompany.com/shutters/): Hunter Douglas wood, composite and vinyl shutters
- [Drapery and curtains](https://www.johncrawfordcompany.com/drapery/): Fabrics, lining and hardware
- [Furniture upholstery](https://www.johncrawfordcompany.com/upholstery/): Sofa and chair reupholstery, quoted per piece

## Services

- [Free in-home consultation and measuring](https://www.johncrawfordcompany.com/services/consultation-measuring/)
- [Window treatment installation](https://www.johncrawfordcompany.com/services/window-treatment-installation/)
- [Blind and shade repair](https://www.johncrawfordcompany.com/services/blind-shade-repair/): Send photos and a description so the product and parts can be reviewed
- [Commercial window treatments](https://www.johncrawfordcompany.com/services/commercial-window-treatments/): Blinds and shades for offices, restaurants and businesses
